items.headline: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: OpenAI has announced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, designed with improved professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost. The models are available across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
items.why_it_matters: The update provides tools intended to improve professional tasks and coding efficiency at a reduced cost.
items.evidence_quote: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost

items.headline: OpenAI works with NATO on cyber defences
items.summary: OpenAI is collaborating with NATO and allied cyber agencies to support trusted defenders. The partnership focuses on finding vulnerabilities, testing fixes, and safeguarding essential systems.
items.why_it_matters: The collaboration aims to use AI tools to assist security agencies in protecting critical infrastructure.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help trusted defenders find vulnerabilities, test fixes and protect essential systems.

items.headline: Jensen Huang signals willingness to return as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: In his first public statement following his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang indicated that he is willing to return to his former role as chief executive.
items.why_it_matters: Huang's statement marks his first public reaction regarding a potential return to Nvidia following his resignation.
items.evidence_quote: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

items.headline: Petition circulates to reinstate Jensen Huang at Nvidia
items.summary: A petition seeking to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO has gathered support on social media, attracting prominent signatories such as Elon Musk.
items.why_it_matters: The petition reflects public calls by industry figures to bring Huang back to Nvidia.
items.evidence_quote: On Friday, a petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia began circulating on social media

items.headline: Proton launches Lumo desktop application
items.summary: Proton has released its Lumo Desktop app across Windows, Mac, and Linux. The privacy-oriented tool allows users to automate tasks across files and linked applications with specific access controls.
items.why_it_matters: The application offers a desktop alternative for task automation with granular data access settings.
items.evidence_quote: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps

items.headline: DOJ and Commerce Department investigate Megaspeed
items.summary: The US Justice and Commerce Departments have confirmed they are investigating Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed. The company is connected to the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
items.why_it_matters: The joint investigation examines a firm linked to the recent leadership departure at Nvidia.
items.evidence_quote: The Justice and Commerce Departments said that they are investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center company
